Name: Bara Anthro Albert PORTRAIT
Author: Entifrisky
Description:
Based from these two mods

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Anthro Characters Continued - (Furry Overhaul Mod) Plus Genderswaps[/url]

inspired from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/139996778]BaraEnthusiast[/url] works

My friend Benjorezz have edited the original furry portraits to where Albert is barafied!

Just use the 2 pictures to replace the Albert's portraits in the folder of the Anthro Characters Continued Portrait folder.

Don't forget to edit:
"Abigail_Beach - by Bebby" --into--> "Abigail_Beach"

and
"Abigail - by Bebby" --into--> "Abigail"

for it to actually work and replace the originals you have!
